title: Social-Choice Axiom Audit of Preference Aggregation in DPO

original_idea.body:
# Social-Choice Axiom Audit of Preference Aggregation in DPO

**Problem:** It is unclear which social-choice axioms the implicit DPO aggregation rule violates.

**Direction:** Construct synthetic preference datasets with controlled group disagreement, run DPO, test for IIA and dictatorship violations.

**Why it matters:** Turns impossibility theorems into measurable pipeline behaviors. Synthetic data.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2404.10271; arXiv:2404.13038.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Pluralistic-alignment fairness is recognized but the chain to catastrophic-risk reduction is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Synthetic data plus DPO and axiom checks; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused violation-frequency deliverable; needs constructed disagreement datasets.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Synthetic data, no lab ownership of pluralistic-alignment fairness.

low_compute.reasoning: Small synthetic DPO runs on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Conceptual mapping argued; empirical axiom-violation measurement may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Conceptual mapping exists; empirical axiom audit may be open.
